me.mrCookieSlime.CSCoreLibPlugin.Configuration

Class Config

  • java.lang.Object
    • me.mrCookieSlime.CSCoreLibPlugin.Configuration.Config
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    BlockInfoConfig

    public class Config
extends java.lang.Object
    An old remnant of CS-CoreLib. This will be removed once we updated everything. Don't look at the code, it will be gone soon, don't worry. Only used by the legacy BlockStorage system.
